page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head and page number at the top and a catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nec ab impressoribus ut illis mos est dis-solvatur, nec ullo pacto aut laceretur aut deturpetur, nam, etsi plura exempla-ria typographiae ac diligentiae tuae bene-ficio in lucem sint proditura, nihilomi-nus ad illorum fidem magis confirman-dam; hoc manuscriptum Musæi[?] nostri, quantulumcunque illud sit, insigne orna-mentum, perpetuo adservare Plurimii[?] fa-cimus. Postremo deinque[?] oprandum[?] mi-hi est, & a benignitate tua me facile im-petraturum confido, ut in perquirendo hoc libro non mediocris in Asia atque in Ægypto adhibitæ diligentiæ, atque in il-lo per tot tantaque itinera Romam usque feliciter, ut Deo placuit, deferendo labo-ris insumpti non leve mihi præmium, in illius impressione aliqua mentio fiat mei, qui totum hoc præstiti in Ecclesiæ Catho-licæ obsequium atque literatorum oble-ctamentum; & quomodo illud habuea-rim, ubi, & quando ac de omnibus cir-cumstantiis ad hoc pertinentibus, cum opus fuerit, te certiorem facere non pige-bit. Interim accipe R. Pater hoc aliud

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Musæi" (the word after "manuscriptum" looks like Mufxi, possibly a long-s form; [?] applied). "Plurimii" and "deinque" (rendered "deniqve" in print; I normalised the vowel u) and "oprandum" (the letters look like "oprandum", possibly "optandum") are uncertain. "fa-cimus" is split at the line end with a damaged "c" at the start of the next line. The catchword "speci" is printed at the bottom right. The reading of "fpcci" is taken as the long s "speci". The paragraph has no indent, so it is one continuing paragraph from the previous page.
